desc: The CZ DUTY 4.0F is a 9mm pistol featuring a 4.0" barrel, medium grip frame, and 19-round capacity. This configuration incorporates an optics-ready (OR) design for mounting compatible reflex sights, allowing shooters to customize their sighting setup. The pistol also features a manual safety (MS), providing an additional user-operated safety control. Its combination of optics-ready capability, manual safety, medium grip frame, and 19-round capacity distinguishes this variant within the DUTY 4.0F lineup.
